modules.heading: About Sample Runner
modules.body:
Sample Runner is a fast-paced endless-runner where you sprint, jump and slide through procedurally generated streets. Collect coins, dodge obstacles, and unlock new characters as you progress.

The goal is simple: survive as long as possible while racking up the highest score. Each run is different — perfect for short play sessions or long-haul leaderboard chases.

items.title: Endless running
items.body: Procedurally generated levels mean no two runs are alike.

items.title: Daily challenges
items.body: New missions every day to keep things fresh.

items.title: Global leaderboard
items.body: Compete with players around the world for the top score.

modules.heading: How to play
modules.intro: Sample Runner uses simple, intuitive controls that work on desktop and mobile.

items.title: Move
items.body: Use the arrow keys or swipe left/right to switch lanes.

items.title: Jump
items.body: Press space or swipe up to jump over obstacles.

items.title: Slide
items.body: Press down or swipe down to slide under barriers.

items.q: Is Sample Runner free to play?
items.a: Yes — every game on this site is free, no installs required.
Yes. The game adapts to touch input on phones and tablets.
Scores are saved locally in your browser.
